Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly switched the identified director from Josef Mach (the 1963 film’s director) to František Filip (a TV series director), conflating the TV series with the film and prematurely asserting a birthplace (Písek) without proper verification. This misidentification would lead to the wrong birthplace for the director of the film.
